read_order_note: This reproduction's data_pool.load_pool() iterates config['train_weeks'] in list order (identical to DCSA's week_paths(data_root, platform, train_weeks, 'train') + load_samples_from_paths(), which appends files in that same list order and preserves within-file row order). No filesystem glob or sort-by-name is used anywhere in this reproduction, so file read order is guaranteed identical to the original pipeline given the same config file.
cache_dir_appledouble_note: The external drive surfaces one macOS AppleDouble shadow file ('._<name>.npz', zero-length metadata, not real data) per real cache file, so a naive glob('*.npz') count is exactly double the real file count. n_cache_files_built above already excludes these; load_week() in data_pool.py opens files by exact name, never by glob, so this artifact cannot affect which data is actually loaded.
train_weeks_count_note: The config's train_weeks list contains exactly 52 distinct ISO weeks (2023-09-24_2023-09-30 through 2024-09-15_2024-09-21), matching the manuscript text ('52 weekly files'), confirmed here by directly counting config['train_weeks'] and the on-disk file list.
